products.name: Public Foundation
products.purpose: Publish the public evidence, provenance, schemas, reproducible Runs, Results, and release controls on which every later HMS product depends.
products.required_gate: Continue to admit material only through the public evidence and release gates.

products.name: Expedition Verifier
products.purpose: Deterministically verify an Expedition submission without disclosing sealed solution material.
products.required_gate: Deploy the sealed HTTPS verification service with edge controls, configure the public client, pass accepted/rejected and abuse tests plus clean-environment UAT, then bind human approval to the exact service and package.

products.name: Public GP29 Calculator
products.purpose: Provide deterministic GP29 calculation and inspection without implying cryptanalytic meaning.
products.required_gate: Maintain the approved GP29-v0.1.1 public boundary; all future changes require a new immutable software subject.

products.name: Corpus Manifest Verifier
products.purpose: Determine whether a selected folder exactly matches a declared corpus manifest.
products.required_gate: Complete clean-environment human UAT and approve the exact checksum-identified Windows package; canonical binding, the five-case synthetic suite, and the desktop usability pass are complete.

products.name: Endeavour Lite
products.purpose: Unify the qualified public instruments in a coherent local-first research workstation.
products.required_gate: Complete recovery and privacy review of the integrated fail-closed Expedition client, pass clean-environment human UAT, and approve the exact checksum-identified package; the unified local workflows and automated Windows qualification pass.

products.name: Liber Runtime Beta
products.purpose: Provide the interactive Liber Primus Atlas, Workbench, experiment, evidence, and research-history environment.
products.required_gate: Advance the implemented metadata Atlas, Rune Workbench, bounded GP29 experiment, and local history into page-aware Regions, general experiments/comparison, Auto Explore, and Evidence as separately accepted increments before an integrated beta.

products.name: Advanced Instruments
products.purpose: Add individually contracted cryptanalytic, rune, geometry, runtime, evidence, and research-history modules.
products.required_gate: Each module requires its own instrument contract, tests, capability gate, limitations, and human release approval.

products.name: Full HMS / AEGIS Research Station
products.purpose: Integrate HMS orchestration, Liber Runtime, qualified instruments, and permission-bounded AEGIS assistance under the AEGIS Trust Core.
products.required_gate: The underlying public tools, Runtime increments, evidence controls, entitlements, privacy boundaries, recovery, and plugin permissions must be independently usable and accepted first.
